issue.title: Extra space in error and warning section

repository.name: vim-airline
repository.description: lean & mean status/tabline for vim that's light as air

issue.body:
#### environment

- vim: nvim 0.3.0
- vim-airline: 0.8
- OS: Ubuntu 16.04
- Have you reproduced with a minimal vimrc: Yes
```
call plug#begin('~/.vim/plugged')

Plug 'vim-airline/vim-airline' 

call plug#end()

let g:airline_powerline_fonts = 1
```

- What is your airline configuration: default
if you are using terminal:
- terminal: Gnome terminal
- $TERM variable: xterm-256color
- color configuration (:set t_Co?): not found
if you are using Neovim:
- does it happen in Vim: sorry, cannot find the original binary at the moment.

#### actual behavior

There is an extra space in warning/error section, `let g:airline_section_warning = ""` removes it while using the above minimal vimrc. With my actual .vimrc I also need to add `let g:airline_section_error = ""` (probably because I have syntastic installed)

![extra space](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/70747/41496875-09d4affe-714a-11e8-93e5-064cfb27ba0a.png)

#### expected behavior

![no space](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/70747/41496877-1c7c72ae-714a-11e8-9241-f66e9af0a274.png)

Thanks!

issue.title: Strange issue with utf8 symbols in completion menu

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
- `nvim --version`: 0.3.0
- Vim (version: 8.1.22) behaves _correctly_
- Operating system/version: Arch Linux (recently updated)
- Terminal name/version: urxvt v9.22
- `$TERM`: xterm

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

1. Create file test with content:

    ```
    testø
    testæ
    testå
    ```

2. Go to last line, do `o<c-n>` to open keyword completion menu.

### Actual behaviour

The letters `æøå` are not displayed correctly, see screenshot:

![screen](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/998898/42123559-648dc736-7c54-11e8-99da-dfd21eb724f8.png)

### Expected behaviour

The letters are displayed correctly.
